denial_ground_truth.denial_reason_text: Submitted documentation does not establish participation in a comprehensive weight management program with continuing follow-up for at least 6 months prior to using drug therapy.
denial_ground_truth.cited_policy_reference: Aetna Pharmacy Clinical Policy Bulletin, "Weight Loss (BMI 35) GIP-GLP-1 GLP-1 Agonists PA with Limit 6450-C UDR 05-2024," COVERAGE CRITERIA — Chronic Weight Management (Adult)

policy_ground_truth.policy_name: Weight Loss (BMI 35) GIP-GLP-1 GLP-1 Agonists PA with Limit 6450-C UDR 05-2024

criteria.requirement: Participation in a comprehensive weight management program encouraging behavioral modification, reduced calorie diet, and increased physical activity, with continuing follow-up, for at least 6 months prior to using drug therapy.
criteria.policy_support_text: The patient has participated in a comprehensive weight management program that encourages behavioral modification, reduced calorie diet, and increased physical activity with continuing follow-up for at least 6 months prior to using drug therapy

criteria.requirement: Patient is 18 years of age or older.
criteria.policy_support_text: The patient is 18 years of age or older

criteria.requirement: Baseline BMI greater than or equal to 35 kg/m2, with documentation.
criteria.policy_support_text: The patient has a baseline body mass index (BMI) greater than or equal to 35 kg/m2 [ACTION REQUIRED: Documentation is required for approval.]

criteria.requirement: The requested drug will be used with a reduced calorie diet and increased physical activity for chronic weight management.
criteria.policy_support_text: used with a reduced calorie diet and increased physical activity for chronic weight management

scope_notes: This policy's adult chronic weight management pathway has no BMI 30 route and no BMI 27-plus-comorbidity route. There is no weight-related comorbidity criterion in this pathway at all.
The BMI 27 threshold in this document belongs solely to the Risk Reduction of Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events (Adult) - Wegovy ONLY pathway, which is not the pathway of this request.
This policy contains no step therapy requirement.

evidence_ground_truth.evidence_timing_note: The 2026-05-12 progress note predates the 2026-06-04 PA submission but was not included in it. The denial reviewed only the PA form and a one-page visit summary dated 2026-06-01.

expected_evidence.evidence_text: Eight dated weight-management contacts from 09/08/2025 through 04/20/2026: registered-dietitian visits at Willow Creek Nutrition Services on 09/08/2025, 10/06/2025, 12/15/2025, 01/26/2026, 03/30/2026 and 04/20/2026, and behavioral group sessions at Lakeview Wellness Center on 11/17/2025 and 02/23/2026. Span is 7 months 12 days; the longest gap between contacts is 6 weeks.
expected_evidence.evidence_location: OUTSIDE RECORDS AND CARE COORDINATION section; corroborated in SUBJECTIVE

expected_evidence.evidence_text: The three components the policy names are each documented separately: reduced calorie diet (calorie target set and food logging started 09/08/2025; 'counting to about 1,500 a day'); behavioral modification (group sessions on eating triggers and meal planning); increased physical activity (walking 30-35 minutes most weekday mornings, activity plan stepped up 01/26/2026, resistance band program added 03/30/2026).
expected_evidence.evidence_location: SUBJECTIVE; OUTSIDE RECORDS AND CARE COORDINATION

expected_evidence.evidence_text: Height 5 ft 5 in, weight 219 lb, BMI 36.4 kg/m2 on 05/12/2026; earliest recorded weight 232 lb, BMI 38.6, on 09/08/2025. Every recorded BMI in the episode is at or above 36.4.
DOB 03/19/1974; age 52 at the time of the request.
Plan states the patient 'will continue the 1,400-1,600 kcal/day plan and the walking program at 30 minutes five days per week' alongside the requested medication.

missing_evidence.description: Documentation of the two Lakeview Wellness Center group sessions the patient reports attending after 04/20/2026. These are patient-reported only; the note states documentation has been requested and is not yet in the chart. They are not needed to satisfy the 6-month requirement.
The Willow Creek 04/20/2026 program summary letter is referenced as on file at Willow Creek but is not reproduced in the note.

per_criterion.reason: Dated contacts span 09/08/2025 to 04/20/2026, seven months and twelve days, exceeding six months, with continuing follow-up at intervals of three to six weeks and documentation of all three components the policy names. No weight-loss drug therapy had been started, so the entire period precedes drug therapy.
BMI 36.4 kg/m2 documented with height and weight, above the 35 kg/m2 threshold; baseline 38.6 kg/m2. Not disputed by the payer.
Plan continues a specified reduced-calorie diet and walking program alongside the drug.

supported_claims: The record contains dated evidence of weight-management participation spanning more than seven months with continuing follow-up, prior to any drug therapy, satisfying the criterion the denial says was not met.
The evidence existed in the patient's chart before the prior authorization was submitted and was simply not included in the submission, so it is properly considered on reconsideration.
The program documented includes all three components the policy names: behavioral modification, reduced calorie diet, and increased physical activity.
The BMI criterion of 35 kg/m2 or greater is met at 36.4 kg/m2 and is not in dispute.
unsupported_claims: That the member exhausted or failed other anti-obesity pharmacotherapy.
That the program was formally accredited, insurer-approved, or physician-supervised.
That the member meets the continuation-of-therapy criteria.
That the member's comorbidities are relevant to eligibility under this pathway.

facts_allowed_in_appeal: Dated weight-management contacts are documented from September 8, 2025 through April 20, 2026, a span of seven months and twelve days.
Eight contacts are documented: six registered-dietitian visits at Willow Creek Nutrition Services and two behavioral group sessions at Lakeview Wellness Center.
The longest interval between documented contacts is six weeks.
A calorie target and food logging were started at the 09/08/2025 nutrition consultation.
The activity plan was stepped up on 01/26/2026 and a resistance band program was added on 03/30/2026.
Documented BMI on May 12, 2026 was 36.4 kg/m2, with height 5 feet 5 inches and weight 219 pounds.
Weight decreased from 232 pounds on 09/08/2025 to 219 pounds on 05/12/2026.
The member had received no weight-loss pharmacotherapy and no GLP-1 receptor agonist prior to this request.
The plan of care continues a 1,400-1,600 kcal/day diet and walking 30 minutes five days per week alongside the requested medication.
facts_not_allowed_in_appeal: The member failed a trial of phentermine, phentermine/topiramate, naltrexone/bupropion, or orlistat.
Aetna's policy requires a trial of a preferred anti-obesity agent before Wegovy.
This policy permits coverage at a BMI of 30 kg/m2, or at 27 kg/m2 with a weight-related comorbidity.
The member's hypertension and dyslipidemia satisfy a weight-related comorbidity requirement in the pathway at issue.
The member completed twelve months of a weight management program.
The member has completed at least three months of Wegovy at a stable maintenance dose.
The weight management program was accredited, insurer-approved, or physician-supervised.
The two Lakeview Wellness Center sessions after April 20, 2026 are documented in the record.
The member's 5.6 percent weight reduction satisfies the coverage criterion at issue.
